newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble edges up as banks seek funds to buy T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Rouble edges up as banks seek funds to buy T-bills.

text.p: The rouble edged up in lively trading on Monday ahead of Wednesday's government bond auctions and on demand of some major operators, dealers said.
On Wednesday, December 18, the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of six-month T-bills and two trillion roubles of OFZ bonds.
Roubles/dollar Dec 16 midday Dec 16 early Dec 15 close
"The rouble firmed -- banks seem to be seeking funds for the auctions," one dealer saying one major bank was especially active in buying roubles.

Dealers said the market was otherwise calm ahead of New Year holidays. They added it was unaffected by news that the State Duma had passed the 1997 draft budget in a first reading on Sunday, which was a working day in Russia.
"The rouble/dollar market is controlled strictly by the central bank, so no reaction (to the budget) was likely," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
